The PR itself edits PRE_RELEASE_DOCS.md with usage examples, confirming the maintainers consider this a documented public API surface change.

Such a fix changes observable behavior for a class of input and warrants a changelog/security note, mirroring the accepted worked example of the __proto__ passthrough fix.
rows.label_rationale: Security fix closing a prototype-pollution vector in .passthrough()/.catchall()/looseObject() (linked GitHub security advisories). This changes documented-schema parsing behavior for a security-sensitive input and warrants a docs/changelog note.

rows.title: Make z.preprocess defer optionality to inner schema
rows.model_rationale: This changes observable behavior of the documented z.preprocess: optionality now defers to the inner schema, so `z.object({ x: z.preprocess(v=>v, z.number().optional()) }).safeParse({})` now succeeds where it previously failed. It also introduces new public types (ZodPreprocess, $ZodPreprocess) and updates the core docs type list. Both are user-facing.
rows.label_rationale: Introduces a new exported ZodPreprocess class and changes how z.preprocess()'s optionality is inferred from the inner schema. The PR itself edits packages/docs/content/packages/core.mdx, confirming it's a documented public API change.

rows.title: fix(v4): generalize optin/fallback to transform; restore preprocess on absent keys

These are user-facing behavior changes to documented schema methods, not internal-only refactors. The wiki/optionality.md is internal and unpublished, but the source changes in schemas.ts warrant a docs/changelog note.
rows.label_rationale: Changes how .optional() interacts with .catch()/.transform()/.preprocess() across pipe boundaries on absent input — a documented schema-composition behavior that previously produced wrong results (e.g. transform output leaking through an outer .optional()).
